name: Sida (Swedish International Development Cooperation Agency)

zero_reason.quote: Here is a list of Sida’s call processes that are are no longer open for application.

collect_note: Reads Sida's Calls and announcements page (accordion lists) and keeps items whose title says research. Its only research item, the 2025 Zambia research-capacity call on calls.sida.se, sits in the closed list and is excluded by name (none Zambia) so it is not shown as open; the filter 'research' matches its title, so the filter is tested. Current announcements on the page list no research call (expect 0 open). Routes tried: sitemap.xml lists both pages (no call feed or JSON endpoint found by endpoint_recon); calls.sida.se is a Moodle course site with no listing. The research-calls page lists partner-run calls (JPIAMR, AI4D, OWSD, TWAS, IFS, AERC) that have their own rows, so they are not collected here. Mode calls, not page: the listing is a real calls section. Undated items get no deadline.
